projects.title: Designer
projects.summary: An experimental agentic UX design harness that moves generative design upstream. Designer frames the problem, produces differentiated hypotheses, and builds selected directions into working prototypes so the ideas can be judged in use.
projects.detail: The useful result was not simply the interface. The experiment exposed where agentic design helped—and where it did not. Hypothesis generation produced genuinely different bets; a human-shaped canvas and adversarial evaluation loop became bottlenecks. Those findings now point toward a leaner, headless system of coordinating agents.

leadImage.alt: Designer canvas connecting a design brief and supporting inputs to three distinct product hypotheses and working prototype previews.

supportingImage.alt: Designer canvas with nodes for the brief, research, objectives, design system, constraints, and hypothesis incubator.
